title: A Cover for the Safehouse
author: Petra Reyes
blurb: Elodie Brightwater, a crash investigator whose family died in row twelve, keeps a go-bag packed and a lie polished. But when a stranger returns a favor that never happened, with interest owed, he discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. Now he must trade the one secret worth killing for, and time is already running out.
style: richly descriptive with an intimate third-person narration
